say:1:1520634001:1.text: Matthew, finally! It's dangerous around here, you need to come back with us!
say:1:1520634001:1.source_cn: 马修，可算找到你了！这里很危险，快和我回去！

say:2:1520634002:1.text: Keira... is that you? You must be... The God of Harvest saved you, saved you again...
say:2:1520634002:1.source_cn: 奎莉……你在这里吗？你一定在这里……是丰饶神救了你，再...

say:3:1520634003:1.text: Matthew? Matthew! Are you listening to me?
say:3:1520634003:1.source_cn: 马修？马修！你在听我说话吗？

say:4:1520634004:1.text: We must always praise the God of Harvest... he loves us, he saves us...
say:4:1520634004:1.source_cn: 要时时刻刻称颂丰饶神……他爱着我们，拯救我们……

say:5:1520634005:1.text: <style="highlight">He will save you again, just like when you were a child...</style>
